fields.description: Order-level coupon value, allocated to lines pro rata

description: One product on an order with fully derived price waterfall.

description: Customer's request to return part of one order (the RMA).
lifecycle: REQUESTED → AUTHORIZED | REJECTED; AUTHORIZED → IN_TRANSIT | EXPIRED; IN_TRANSIT → RECEIVED | SHIPMENT_LOST; RECEIVED → INSPECTED → COMPLETED

checks.name: ck_rr_override
checks.expr: (override_flag = FALSE) OR (override_reason IS NOT NULL AND override_by IS NOT NULL)

fields.name: requested_at
fields.description: When the customer raised the request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current lifecycle state (projection of the latest event)

description: One order line on an RMA with its eligibility decision.

fields.name: requested_qty
fields.description: Units the customer asked to return

fields.name: approved_qty
fields.rule: <= returnable qty (purchased - previously approved); 0 when rejected

description: Formal decision on an RMA (1:1; system decides synchronously, overrides by an operator).
Reverse-logistics parcel for an authorised RMA.
lifecycle: LABEL_CREATED → IN_TRANSIT → RECEIVED | LOST; LABEL_CREATED → EXPIRED

description: Warehouse grading of a received return line.
Every refund attempt, successful or blocked (append-only).

fields.name: attempt_no
fields.description: 1 for first attempt on the line

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.description: Client-supplied key; replays return the stored result

fields.name: processed_at
fields.description: When the payment rail confirmed (or the guard rejected) the attempt

fields.name: item_amount_paise
fields.description: Item value refunded after grade factor

fields.name: requested_amount_paise
fields.rule: = item + tax - restocking - shipping for computed attempts
fields.description: Amount this attempt asked to pay (computed, or an operator goodwill amount)

fields.name: amount_paise
fields.rule: = max(0, item + tax - restocking - shipping); cumulative <= line_paid_paise
fields.description: Net paid out (0 for blocked attempts)

description: Where returned units go; controls inventory movement.
Append-only audit trail of every state change.
